description: Labeled retrieval queries over data/sample_faq.json. 'relevant' lists the FAQ questions (citation titles) that answer the query. Paraphrases are deliberate: several queries share few or no words with their answer, so lexical retrieval cannot get them all.

cases.query: I forgot my password and can't log in
relevant: How do I reset my password?

cases.query: the password reset link expired
relevant: How do I reset my password?

cases.query: when is your support team available?
relevant: What are your business hours?

cases.query: are you open on weekends
relevant: What are your business hours?

cases.query: how can I send back an item I bought
relevant: How do I return a product?

cases.query: how many days do I have to return a purchase
relevant: How do I return a product?

cases.query: how many days until my package arrives
relevant: How long does shipping take?

cases.query: do you have free shipping?
relevant: How long does shipping take?

cases.query: expedited or overnight delivery options
relevant: How long does shipping take?

cases.query: I want to cancel my order

cases.query: can I modify an order after placing it
relevant: Can I change or cancel my order?

cases.query: where is my order right now

cases.query: tracking email for my shipment
relevant: How do I track my order?
